purpose: Separate repository activity from publication. Cloudflare is the canonical NayaNET Hub runtime; deployment remains an explicitly authorized side effect.

requirements: canonical Cloudflare account and Worker binding

non_deploying_changes: ordinary source commits unless explicitly authorized for release
bypass_prohibition: No GitHub workflow, repository event, commit, branch push, pull request, note, document, or automation may invoke Cloudflare deployment outside the canonical release workflow and release authorization contract.
truth_rule: CONNECTED != DEPLOYABLE; COMMITTED != RELEASED; VERIFIED != PRODUCTION_PROVEN; AUTHORIZED != SUCCESSFUL UNTIL DEPLOYMENT EVIDENCE EXISTS.
